newsitem.title: USA: Centennial names interim CEO, CFO. [CORRECTED 21:30 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Centennial names interim CEO, CFO. [CORRECTED 21:30 GMT]

text.p: Centennial Technologies Inc said Tuesday it had hired an interim chief executive officer and a chief financial officer.
Centennial said Lawrence Ramaekers of Boca Raton, Fla., has assumed the post of CEO, and Eugene Bullis of West Newbury, Mass., has become CFO.

Earlier today the company said it expectd to restate its financial results for fiscal 1996 and the first and second quarters of fiscal 1997, and expects to report losses for all three periods. It also said it was in default of covenants regarding its revolving credit line.

Last week Centennial said it had fired Emanual Pinez, its chief executive, and removed its chief financial officer, James Murphy, and had notified the Securities and Exchange Commission of possible irregularities in its financial statements.
On Friday Pinez, an Israeli citizen, was arrested and ordered held on charges of insider trading, securities fraud and inventory manipulation, according to the federal prosecutor in Boston.
Centennial said Ramaekers is a principal of the Southfield, Mich., firm of Jay Alix & Associates, which specializes in turning around companies beset with financial troubles.

Ramaekers's most recent short-term positions include vice chairman at Ryder Truck Rental Systems Inc; CEO/COO of Color Tile Inc; CEO of Family Restaurants Inc, and president/COO of National Car Rental System Inc.
(Corrects to delete erroneous reference to Ryder System Inc. being parent company of Ryder Truck Rental Systems Inc.)
He has also been involved in turnaround consulting assignments to the boards of Wang Laboratories, UNISYS, Norand and AM International Inc

Bullis is also affiliated with Jay Alix. His 30-year career includes serving as a partner in Ernst & Young, senior financial positions with Wang, and financial consultant to Eastman Kodak and NYNEX, Centennial said.
